claims.statement: The assurance kernel implements runtime SI-dimension algebra and refuses addition of quantities with unequal base-dimension exponent vectors.
nonclaims: Dimensional homogeneity does not establish that an equation is physically correct.

claims.statement: The assurance kernel implements outward-rounded scalar interval addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and square root with fail-closed domain checks.
nonclaims: Scalar interval arithmetic does not represent arbitrary correlated uncertainty without additional dependency modeling.

claims.statement: Separate mass, charge, momentum, and energy control-volume residuals are computed from declared initial, final, source, sink, and boundary terms.
nonclaims: A closed ledger can omit a real physical channel if the control volume is incorrectly specified.

claims.statement: The invariant layer computes Minkowski four-velocity normalization, Lorentz-force power decomposition, electromagnetic field invariants, Poynting flux, Parker-wind flux identities, orbit invariants, and N-body aggregate invariants.
nonclaims: These identities do not solve the nonlinear Einstein equations or validate a plasma-wing force law.

claims.statement: Photon and plasma force requests are checked against explicit momentum-source upper bounds derived from declared irradiance or mass flux and interaction area.
nonclaims: The effective plasma interaction area and momentum multiplier remain model inputs requiring kinetic or experimental support.

claims.statement: A twelve-coordinate similarity signature constrains chamber-to-space and local-to-mission reuse by log-space tolerance and evidence level.
nonclaims: Matching the declared coordinates does not prove that all relevant dimensionless physics has been included.

claims.statement: The closed-cycle audit separately evaluates state closure, moving-medium work identity, actuator and thermal cost, numerical residual, uncertainty interval, and evidence sufficiency.
nonclaims: A synthetic numerical closed cycle is not chamber or flight evidence.

claims.statement: The force-reversal protocol estimates reversible effect, common-mode bias, reversal asymmetry, serial correlation, effective sample size, zero-control drift, an empirical-Bernstein interval, and a sign-flip randomization p-value.
nonclaims: The statistical checks rely on their declared boundedness, exchangeability, and drift assumptions.
A passing synthetic test is not an experimental force measurement.

claims.statement: Scientific promotion is represented as a fail-closed five-tier gate from software finite check through flight propulsion, with missing evidence recorded as explicit blocker bits.
nonclaims: The existence of a gate does not supply the evidence required to pass it.

claims.statement: The assurance test suite exercises interval containment, dimensional rejection, conservation leak detection, convergence acceptance and rejection, rotational and scaling metamorphisms, relativistic and electromagnetic invariants, force bounds, chamber-reversal failure modes, replication, claim-tier progression, and deterministic replay on bounded generated cases.
nonclaims: Passing bounded tests is not a universal proof of solver correctness.
CI success is not physical validation.

claims.statement: The current project-level claim receipt is intentionally capped below chamber-local-force and propulsion tiers because reversible replicated chamber force, robust hardware closed-cycle, deployment, and flight evidence are absent.
nonclaims: This cap does not assert that the concept is impossible.
It states that the stronger evidence has not yet been supplied.

claims.statement: Demonstrate a reversible transverse plasma force under a preregistered, similarity-qualified, independently replicated chamber protocol with closed momentum, charge, electrical-energy, thermal, and structural ledgers.
required_evidence: positive, negative, and zero command blocks

claims.statement: Demonstrate robust positive net gain over a complete spacecraft control cycle using a force law inside its validated similarity and uncertainty envelope.
required_evidence: uncertainty interval with positive lower bound
